messages:
sam.partnerships: quick thread to nail down a single-source SEV flow for marketplace and HW partners. avoid duplicate bridges + clear 1-line templates.
eli.sre: vote for: vendor webhook -> auto-create #partner-sev-{partner}-{env} -> bot posts bridge -> primary oncall tagged. keep SLAs short: support ack 10m, eng triage 20m for S1.
zoe.support: please add required first message fields so partners include them up front: External-ID, Env, Symptom (1 line), Impact (count), HW-serials (if any), Contact.
harry.integration: important: vendor portals send email+webhook. rule: de-dupe on External-ID; if missing, create one and send back to vendor. also include `customer_context` field in webhook contract.
ops-bot: automation: when channel name matches `partner-sev-*` and webhook verified, running `/bridge create --ttl 6h --record` and posting link.
eli.sre: fallback: if partner can't join bridge within 8m, partnership rep + support create 3-way call, post link, and continue in channel. put link in topic.
sam.partnerships: pre-launch drill: 20m run 48h before listing: webhook -> channel -> bridge -> ack within SLA. i'll schedule and invite partner liaison.
zoe.support: adding tiny post-mortem template for partner comms: one-sentence impact; one-line root cause; one-line mitigation; next steps + ETA; liaison contact.
eli.sre: ownership rule: if open >6h rotate owners on the bridge and note transfer in channel topic (15m handoff meeting).
sam.partnerships: great. i'll convert this to a one-pager and share with CloudForge liaison. no objections by EOD becomes onboarding checklist.
ops-bot: snapshot saved to partnerships/marketplace-sev-procedures on 1748000285.
